name: Sovereign Apps
description: Modular monorepo template for sovereign P2P apps — Electron, React Native and optional installable web presence, powered by Iroh QUIC
lastActionDescription: Integrated the modular communication packages, web-presence Next.js example, generator, release gates and native evidence runbook
nextNeeds: Native BLE and platform mDNS permission/runtime adapters
Clean Node 22 verification, signed support manifest, then stable release decision
blocking: Automated gates pass, but stable support is blocked by missing physical iOS/Android evidence, native BLE/mDNS runtime measurements, and the skipped real two-node Iroh fixture

packages.protocol: @sovereign-apps/protocol — versioned framing, signed presence, pairing and LAN discovery
packages.electron-app: @sovereign-apps/electron-app — Electron Iroh responder/dialer, identity, QR and mDNS
packages.react-native-app: @sovereign-apps/react-native-app — React Native Iroh bridge, pairing and LAN browser
packages.ble-bootstrap: @sovereign-apps/ble-bootstrap — bounded BLE bootstrap codec and adapter contracts
packages.offline-bootstrap: @sovereign-apps/offline-bootstrap — deep-link, file/share and NFC handoff contracts
packages.web-presence: @sovereign-apps/web-presence — framework-neutral signed presence with Next.js factories
packages.web-presence-nextjs-example: apps/landing — minimal installable Next.js web-presence example, not a landing

protocol.transport: Iroh QUIC with n0 relay + direct hole-punch
